senses.gloss: m. (חָפַשׂ) search, use of the root חפש.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 7b">Pes. 7ᵇ</cite> we learn <he>מציאה מח׳</he> the meaning of <he>מצא</he> (<cite ref="Exodus 12:19">Ex. XII, 19</cite>) from the expression <he>חפש</he> (connected with <he>מצא</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 44:12">Gen. XLIV, 12</cite>), i.e. you must search after leavened bread before Passover, &c.
